sources.label: Pokémon GO related patches for apps I use.
sources.author: DanielTheManiel
patch_list: Tap Bounty to open Daily Reward; long press it to open Bounty.

Checks daily reward eligibility and automatically claims it (bypassing ads) if available. Invoke by sending intent as broadcast, with action app.danielthemaniel.pokeraid.CHECK_DAILY_REWARD, and package me.pokeraid.
Disables ads locally using PokeRaid's built-in Disabled ad strategy.
Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, and Advertising ID collection while preserving app functionality.
Hides PokeRaid announcement carousels without breaking Data Binding.
Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived Material You colors throughout PokeRaid while preserving semantic status and raid-type colors.
Adds an optimistic JOIN button to room cards using PokeRaid's stock authenticated join request.
